title: Building the Motivation for Success: Part 8
summary: Kahran and Divya talk about externalizing the hard parts of creative work — treating the muse, or motivation itself, as something outside you so the load on your conscious brain lets up. The conversation drifts into embodied versus cognitive knowing, the artists they're collaborating with through the podcast, and Divya's just-back-from-a-death-in-the-family take on Hindu funeral rituals.
topics: rituals after a death in the family

intents.display: to think about externalizing motivation so creative work feels lighter
to hear an atheist sit with funeral rituals and grief
